bio.text: Cait Conley, a West Point graduate, won the Democratic nomination in New York's 17th Congressional District on June 23, 2026, according to the Associated Press as reported by Spectrum News.
She served 16 years as an active-duty Army officer, deploying six times to combat zones in Iraq and Afghanistan.
She also served as director for counterterrorism on the National Security Council and at the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency.
She faces Republican Rep. Mike Lawler in the November general election.

sources.title: Cait Conley wins Democratic nomination for NY-17 seat
